caption: Agents next to the workloads add local metadata; a load-balancing tier routes each trace to one gateway, which tail-samples and holds the backend credentials.
alt: Applications send OTLP to an agent Collector running on the same node, which adds Kubernetes attributes. Agents forward to a load-balancing Collector tier that routes spans by trace ID, so every span of a trace reaches the same gateway Collector. Gateway Collectors run tail sampling, redaction and batching, then export traces to a tracing backend and metrics to Prometheus.
